response.justification: The candidate lacks direct experience with C++ or Rust in geospatial routing pipelines, despite extensive full-stack and web-focused work; their GIS work is open-source and non-commercial, with no evidence of routing tile optimization, real-time traffic integration, or distributed systems for production navigation data pipelines.
strengths: Extensive open-source GIS experience with GISCollective
Strong track record in distributed systems and low-latency services using DLang and Node.js
Proven ability to learn and contribute across diverse tech stacks
concerns: No demonstrated commercial C++ or Rust experience required for the role
GIS work is academic/community-focused, not production routing tile systems
Lacks explicit experience with routing data freshness, consistency, or navigation QA
